decision_rule: Use free football-side sources first. Introduce paid data only if a required weekly field becomes unavailable, stale, or operationally unreliable enough to degrade projections.

sources.name: nflverse / nflreadr
limitations: Participation/route data from 2023 onward is not updated during the season.
Current injury data cannot be treated as covered by nflverse for 2025+.

sources.name: Fantasy Life Utilization Report
sources.usage_rule: Use as the primary free weekly utilization reference. Automation is optional; preserve source date/week and do not fabricate missing fields.

sources.name: StatRankings
sources.usage_rule: Use as secondary verification and as fallback when Fantasy Life utilization is missing or ambiguous.

sources.name: NFL.com official injury reports
sources.usage_rule: Official practice and game-status designations are authoritative once the regular-season reporting window begins. Preserve report date/time.

sources.name: FantasyPros injury/news feed
sources.usage_rule: Use for camp, between official reports, and contextual updates; do not override an official NFL game-status designation without newer direct evidence.

sources.name: NFL Savant
limitations: Current site data is labeled through 2025; route/charting data ultimately relies on nflverse/FTN sources.
sources.usage_rule: Historical verification only; not a required live 2026 route feed.

sources.name: PFF public weekly usage reports
sources.usage_rule: Manual spot-check only; never a required automated dependency.

fallback_rules: If Fantasy Life is available, use it as the primary weekly utilization source.
If Fantasy Life is missing or ambiguous, cross-check StatRankings and nflverse snap/usage data.
For injuries, use NFL.com official practice/game-status reports once available; use FantasyPros/news only as current context or fallback.

If a route field is unavailable for an established full-time WR1/WR2, do not block projection generation solely for that reason; use target share, TPRR, air-yard share, red-zone role, and stable snap/usage evidence.
For TEs, receiving RBs, fringe WRs, injury returns, and depth-chart changes, missing route participation lowers confidence and may trigger REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Never substitute sportsbook data for a missing football-side input.
paid_source_trigger: Revisit paid feeds only if the free hierarchy repeatedly fails to provide a materially important pregame field with sufficient freshness or reliability.
